manifest.name: dsh-session-delete-button
manifest.description: Adds a delete-session action (hover button + menu row) right beside the archive action in the DSH web sidebar

bundle.text:
# dsh-session-delete-button — profile patch shipped with the package.
# `dsh plugin --profile <name> add` registers the package as a bundle layer, so
# this insert list applies automatically; no manual edit of the profile's own
# cordis.patch.yml is needed.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-session-delete-button
      name: dsh-session-delete-button

readme.text:
[中文](#中文) | [English](#english)

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 侧栏增强插件：给会话加一个**标记删除**入口，就放在内置「归档」按钮旁边。标记后会话名被划掉，等 DSH 进程退出、下次启动时统一清除记录；标记期间只要该会话又被追加了对话，标记自动取消。

> 仓库名是 `dsh-session-delete`，包名是 `dsh-session-delete-button`——因为 npm 上 `dsh-session-delete` 已被另一个插件占用。安装时以包名为准。

| 入口 | 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| 会话行悬停 | 归档图标右侧的垃圾桶按钮 | 标记删除（再点一次取消） |
| 会话行 `…` 菜单 | **标记删除** / **取消删除标记** | 同上 |
| 标记之后 | 会话行整行变灰并划掉 | 纯视觉标记，不删任何文件 |

DSH 只要在 GUI 里打开过一个会话，就会把它连同日志写入权一直留在 Host 进程里，直到进程退出。此时删文件会得到"界面里还在、磁盘上没了"的坏状态，当前正在聊的会话更是不能删。所以删除做成两段：

1. **标记**（立即）：只写一条记录 `$DSH_HOME/session-delete-marks.json`，随时可撤，任何会话都能标记——包括你正在打开看的那个；
2. **清除**（下次启动）：DSH 启动时、还没有任何会话被打开，插件逐个删掉被标记会话的目录，并清算工作区账目。

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 标记任意会话（含已打开、正在看的） | 立即生效：行变灰 + 划掉 |
| 再次点击 / 菜单「取消删除标记」 | 撤销标记，行恢复正常 |
| 标记后又往该会话发消息 | Host 收到 `session/event` 里的对话活动事件，自动取消标记 |
| 标记的 id 找不到记录 | 返回 404，提示"可能已经被清除" |
| DSH 启动时 | 删除标记对应目录，并 `unarchive` / `detachSession` |
| 解析出的路径不在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions` 内 | 拒绝删除，只记日志 |

只有真实对话活动会取消标记：`user/message`、`assistant/message`、`developer/message`、`system/message`、`tool/call`、`tool/result`、`turn/start`、`turn/end`。后台的 `session/title`（标题重新生成）、`session/flush`、压缩、模型切换等**不会**取消标记。
划掉效果用一条动态 CSS 实现（`[data-row-key="session:<id>"]{text-decoration:line-through}`），随标记列表重写；页面重新可见时重新拉取标记，多标签页和"Host 自动取消标记"都能同步。

本插件未发布到 npm，按 profile 本地安装：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Firefly-Star/dsh-session-delete.git
$src = ".\dsh-session-delete"
$dst = "$env:DSH_HOME\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-session-delete-button"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dst | Out-Null

再把 `dsh-session-delete-button` 追加到 `$DSH_HOME\profiles\web\package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组末尾，然后重启 DSH（Host 半需要重启，浏览器半随页面刷新加载）。

> 该 profile 之后跑 `pnpm install` 会清掉手工放进 `node_modules` 的目录，需要重新复制。

- `index.js`（Host 半，Cordis 插件）
  - `GET  /dsh-session-delete-button/marks` → `{ ok, ids }`
  - `POST /dsh-session-delete-button/mark` → `{ sessionId, marked }` → `{ ok, ids }`
  - `GET  /dsh-session-delete-button/state` → 诊断：live 会话、live agent、当前标记、标记文件路径
  - 启动时执行一次 purge（异步，不阻塞启动）
- `client.js`（浏览器半，`dsh.client` web bundle）：注册官方插槽
  - `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action`（order 101，紧跟归档 100）
  - `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`（order 401，紧跟归档 400）
  - `shell.overlay`（Toast 提示）
- `cordis.patch.yml`：随包分发的 profile 层，安装后自动挂载

适配 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`：`sessionPersistence.list()` 的 `{ header }` 快照、`locate()` 的 `{ path }`、
`workspaceRegistry` 的 `unarchiveSession` / `list()` / `detachSession`、`ctx.on('session/event')`，
客户端插槽 API（`ctx.slots` / `ctx.locale`）与 `data-row-key` 行标记。Linux / Windows 均可（纯 `node:fs`，无 shell 调用）。

A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) sidebar enhancement: a **mark-for-deletion** action right beside the built-in archive button. A marked session is struck through immediately; its records are purged in one pass the next time DSH starts. If the session receives new conversation events while marked, the mark clears itself.

> The repo is `dsh-session-delete`; the package name is `dsh-session-delete-button` (the former is already taken on npm by an unrelated plugin).

DSH keeps every session you have opened in the GUI live in the Host process — with write ownership of its log — until the process exits. Deleting those files out from under a live session leaves "still in the sidebar, gone on disk", and the session you are chatting in can never be deleted that way. So:

1. **Mark** (immediate): one record in `$DSH_HOME/session-delete-marks.json`, reversible, works for every session including the one you have open;
2. **Purge** (next start): before any session is opened, the Host removes each marked session's directory and settles workspace accounting.

- Marked rows are greyed out and struck through via a single generated CSS rule keyed by `data-row-key="session:<id>"`; no DOM surgery.
- Real conversation events clear a mark (`user/message`, `assistant/message`, `developer/message`, `system/message`, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `turn/start`, `turn/end`). Background `session/title` refreshes, flushes, compaction and model switches do not.
- The purge only ever removes a directory that provably sits under `$DSH_HOME/sessions`; anything else is refused and logged.
- `GET /dsh-session-delete-button/state` reports live sessions, live agents, current marks and the mark-file path.

Not published to npm. Clone, copy the package into your profile's `node_modules` (directory name must be `dsh-session-delete-button`), add `dsh-session-delete-button` to `dsh.profile.bundles` in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, restart DSH.
Targets DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (session persistence snapshots, `workspaceRegistry`, `session/event`, client slot API, `data-row-key`). Linux and Windows.
